answer: Because the karst lockup is policed by the jade escrow, the sable audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large farm as a result freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants forfeit once per identity. That is 15 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
